summary: Deployment-only validation of the demo banking app (Node/Express/Sequelize + MySQL backend proxied via uvicorn shim on :8001, Vite React frontend on :3000). Backend pytest suite (12 tests) executed against the external URL — all pass. Frontend Playwright e2e reached the OTP step successfully and displayed the codeDemo in the UI; final verify-otp click was rate-limited (10/15min on auth routes) because pytest had already consumed most of the budget — the flow itself is functional (proven by pytest which does the full login+verify-otp+access flow).

issues: No data-testid attributes on any inputs/buttons (email, password, OTP cases, submit, resend) — reduces test automation robustness. Cannot be fixed here per user's strict 'no source code changes' rule.

critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiting on /api/auth/* is aggressive (10 req / 15 min per IP). This makes end-to-end UI testing after a pytest suite fragile — consider a higher threshold or environment-specific limits for the demo/preview environment.
Frontend Connexion.jsx has zero data-testid attributes. Add them for reliable automation. Currently reachable only via role/text selectors.

codeDemo is intentionally returned by the API and displayed in the UI in demo mode (SMTP absent) — this is expected per the app's own logic (demoActif = DEMO_OTP==='true' || !smtpConfigure()). Not a security issue for a demo build but should be off in prod (ensure SMTP is configured in production).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — home + SPA route + login form + OTP step verified in UI; final verify-otp click rate-limited during test but the flow is proven working end-to-end via API
